question: What Are the Types of Pressure Transmitters?
body_html:
Types of pressure transmitters are classified by the pressure reference they use: gauge, absolute, differential and multivariable. Each converts pressure into a signal, typically 4 to 20 mA.

TypeReferenceTypical use
GaugeAtmospheric pressurePump discharge, compressors, water lines
AbsolutePerfect vacuum (sealed)Vacuum and barometric duty
DifferentialDifference between two portsFlow, level, filter drop
MultivariableDP, static pressure and temperature togetherCompensated gas and steam flow
